name: io.github.heidihelena/vahtian
title: Vahtian
description: Reproducibility core over MCP: freeze a corpus with content hashes, check it later for drift, and keep a hash-chained append-only audit ledger. Local stdio server, stdlib-only core; corpora and ledgers stay on the user's machine. The server checks reproducibility and records who did what; it does not judge evidence or establish truth.
